notes.title: Content Update 1.15
notes.content:
Hey! 😎
It's time for a proper quality of life content update. This one's coming to you with the new unlockable game mode "Waves".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211860/a50b89af0e81e5fca2646b0d4417879731ce2aaa.gif[/img]

The new Waves mode features 3 games: Score attack, Survival and Custom. The first two game types are connected to a global leaderboard; get the highest kill score or survive for the longest time! In "Custom" games you can play around with your own time and waves limit without competition. Unlock this mode by completing the game and get the Waves mode achievement.

There's also some graphical updates, which improves the post-processing effects and the resolution scaling. 

And last but not least: a new weapon - straight from Lang's private collection! This one's got some huge kickback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44211860/3a66f17ee82b740e68ca3e4d0177036c7cb2c845.gif[/img]

[u][b]Fixes and additions:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Added unlockable game mode "Waves" with leaderboards.
[*]Added Dithering filter option to settings panel with default setting OFF.
[*]Added new weapon: "Wessersmith" revolver (from Lang's "private collection").
[*]Adjusted resolution scaling.
[*]Updated post-processing effects.
[*]Updated objectives descriptions.
[*]Updated dialogue UI to better distinguish between keyboard and controller inputs.
[*]Some minor bug fixes and adjustments.
[/list]
That's it for now!
[previewyoutube=gj5HzO0GmtE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
Hello!
It's been some time since the last update. I've been working on adding some more unlockable content that will increase the quality of life of the game.

Here's a sneak peak at the Waves mode, which features 3 different games:
[list]
[*][b]Score attack:[/b] Get the highest score over 10 minutes.
[*][b]Survival:[/b] Survive for the longest time.
[*][b]Custom:[/b] Play at your own custom settings. This game is not counted towards the leaderboards.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=gj5HzO0GmtE;full][/previewyoutube]
The waves of enemies will get progressively more difficult. Hopefully you'll gain enough score or survive for as long as possible to grab a spot on the global leaderboard!

Look for this mode in the upcoming update and unlock it by completing the game.

Until next time!

notes.title: Status update
notes.content:
Hello!
Let me start with the good news: The latest version of the game is uploaded and ready to be released on Steam. 

The bad news: I've run into a pretty serious game engine bug (yes, Unity), which has messed up the main scene file. Luckily I had already built and uploaded the latest version before this happened, so the release can go ahead as scheduled. Unfortunately, this hiccup will probably cause significant delays to possible future updates.

I wanted to be as upfront about this as possible so you know what's going on and to set future expectations accordingly regarding game updates.

For now, I will take a step back to take a breather and review the situation. Hopefully this should be fixed as soon as possible. Thank you for your patience and understanding!

Until next time!

tags.bug: The bad news: I've run into a pretty serious game engine bug (yes, Unity), which has messed up the main scene file.

notes.title: Demo update #2

[*] Updated the settings panel and divided it up into tabs: "General", "Video" and "Audio".
[*] Added an option to set the framerate limit in the Video tab.
[*] Added audio volume settings for music and SFX in the Audio tab.
[*] Moved the "HD mode" option to the Video tab.
[*] Improved the setting sliders navigation for Xbox controllers.
[*] Added missing door sound effects.
[*] Adjusted the collisions in the "Boiler room".
[*] Updated the level layout of the "Command quarters" to reflect the full version of the game.
[*] Adjusted the damage of the Combat knife.
[*] Adjusted hitboxes on the heads of enemies.
[/list]

Until next time!
